python_only_boundaries.dynamic_protocols: Python accepts arbitrary mappings, custom numerics, monkey patches, and arbitrary-precision aggregate integers; native Counter uses frozen typed IDs and int64/double lanes.
python_only_boundaries.legacy_summary_csv: Python summary_csv reaches an unbound instance-method call after CSV parsing; the native legacy CSV behavior is covered by its focused unit gate.
python_only_boundaries.native_workers: Configured deterministic gather workers are a native extension; the pinned Python methods expose scalar execution only.
python_only_boundaries.pandas_summary_records: The pinned oracle image has no Pandas; summary_records parity is classified here and covered by the native typed-record unit gate.
